ValidationRule.description: NA Frontline Agents is allowed to assign a case to CCNA FOS Queue, CCNA Quality Specialists Queue, CCNA CIC Bottler Queue, Bottling Company Queue, CCNA Non-Quality Specialists Queue and CCNA Promotion Specialists Queue.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_Frontline_Agent', ISCHANGED( OwnerId ), ISPICKVAL( Country_Code__c , 'US'), OR( AND( BEGINS(OwnerId,'00G'), CONTAINS(LEFT(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName, 4), 'CCNA'), NOT( OR( CONTAINS(RIGHT(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName, 2), 'BC'), Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_CIC_Bottler_Queue', Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_Specialists_Queue', Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_FOS_Queue', Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_Non_Quality_Specialists_Queue', Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'Promo_CES_Queue', Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_Spanish_Queue', Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_French_Queue', Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_Quality_Repeaters_Queue', Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_Refunds_Reschedules_Cancellations' ) ) ), AND( BEGINS(OwnerId,'005'), ISPICKVAL( Owner:User.Country_Code__c , 'US'), NOT(Owner:User.Id = $User.Id) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are only allowed to assign a case to CCNA FOS Queue, Quality Specialists Queue, CCNA CIC Bottler Queue, Bottling Company Queue, Non-Q Specialists Queue, Promotion Specialists Queue, Quality Repeaters Queue and CCNA Refunds/Reschedules/Cancellations.
